overview.overview: Where you areThe Journey NorthAt the Guild hall in Aegis City.Wendhope lies two days north along the frontier road, and the talk on the way is the party's own.The scene is calm.About this storyYou have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.RecentlyYou left The Wendhope Job behind and moved into The Journey North.Open threadsThe party must travel north to Sheridan land and investigate the silent mining village of Wendhope.Ellie's flustered reaction to the party name 'The Second Tries' and her glance toward the tavern arch hints at something she knows or feels.The Second Tries is an untested party — Belle and Dalan have only just joined Max and neither knows him.Dalan warns the Sheridan lands can be tricky and urges leaving soon.The story so farMax Nightriver signed the Adventurers' Guild register in Aegis City three days before the story's checkpoint but had no party, and the Guild sent no one out alone. At the Guild Hall counter, Tobias kept tapping the Wendhope notice — a D-rank posting about a silent mining village in the north that offered more coin than a collapsed mine should be worth — while Ellie hovered with her pen inked, glancing between Belle, a barbarian from the Mountains of Shadow, and Dalan, a quiet elf archer who had drifted between parties for a year.Following along.Waiting for the next reply.
